testcase.name: Scenario: Retain a hidden Tools panel after switching ribbon tabs: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:750:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain a hidden Tools panel after switching ribbon tabs ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is visible ✔ And the Find panel is visible ✔ When the user hides Find from Show Panels on the Tools tab ✔ Then the Find panel disappears from the Tools ribbon ✔ When the user switches to 3D Model and returns to Tools ✔ Then the Find panel remains hidden ✔ When the user opens Show Panels on the Tools tab ✔ Then Find is unchecked and Tutorials remains checked ✔ When the user selects Find ✔ Then the Find panel reappears before Team Web ✔ And Find and Tutorials are both visible
